description: JOIN POLICY: zero-arg/JOIN_CONSTRAINT-return signature rules, a body built on JOIN_CONSTRAINT deciding the policy, SHOW/DESCRIBE shape, one-policy-per-table with FORCE, the three distinct live sentences (generic violation for no join or an OUTER join, unsatisfied constraint for comma joins and constant ON, potential cross-join for self-joins), no exemption for inner selects, GET_DDL rendering the attachment, attached policies undroppable, and WITH JOIN POLICY at CREATE. All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from ddl/JoinPolicyTest (now retired).
